+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { projects, socialLinks, testimonials } from "./portfolio";
+
+describe("portfolio content", () => {
+  it("keeps the approved featured-project order and adjacency", () => {
+    expect(projects.map((project) => project.slug)).toEqual([
+      "bteb-flow",
+      "amar-hisab",
+      "smd-rework-station",
+      "diy-soldering-station",
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("uses email as the primary hiring destination", () => {
+    expect(socialLinks[0]).toMatchObject({ label: "Email", primary: true });
+    expect(socialLinks[0].href).toBe("mailto:frazixgaming22@gmail.com");
+  });
+
+  it("does not publish testimonials before genuine quotes exist", () => {
+    expect(testimonials).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { projects, socialLinks, testimonials } from "./portfolio";
+
+describe("portfolio content", () => {
+  it("keeps the approved featured-project order and adjacency", () => {
+    expect(projects.map((project) => project.slug)).toEqual([
+      "bteb-flow",
+      "amar-hisab",
+      "smd-rework-station",
+      "diy-soldering-station",
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("uses email as the primary hiring destination", () => {
+    expect(socialLinks[0]).toMatchObject({ label: "Email", primary: true });
+    expect(socialLinks[0].href).toBe("mailto:frazixgaming22@gmail.com");
+  });
+
+  it("does not publish testimonials before genuine quotes exist", () => {
+    expect(testimonials).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { projects, socialLinks, testimonials } from "./portfolio";
+
+describe("portfolio content", () => {
+  it("keeps the approved featured-project order and adjacency", () => {
+    expect(projects.map((project) => project.slug)).toEqual([
+      "bteb-flow",
+      "amar-hisab",
+      "smd-rework-station",
+      "diy-soldering-station",
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("uses email as the primary hiring destination", () => {
+    expect(socialLinks[0]).toMatchObject({ label: "Email", primary: true });
+    expect(socialLinks[0].href).toBe("mailto:frazixgaming22@gmail.com");
+  });
+
+  it("does not publish testimonials before genuine quotes exist", () => {
+    expect(testimonials).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

DESIGN.md-83- ### Note on Font Substitutes
DESIGN.md-84- 
DESIGN.md:85: If implementing without access to figmaSans / figmaMono, suitable open-source substitutes are **Inter** (or **Geist**) for the sans, and **JetBrains Mono** (or **Geist Mono**) for the mono. Inter at variable weights closely matches the fine-grained weight axis figmaSans uses; expect to manually adjust line-heights down by ~0.02 to compensate for Inter's slightly taller x-height.

DESIGN.md-87- ## Layout
DESIGN.md-90- 
DESIGN.md-91- - **Base unit**: 8px.
DESIGN.md:92: - **Tokens (front matter)**: `{spacing.hair}` 1px · `{spacing.xxs}` 4px · `{spacing.xs}` 8px · `{spacing.sm}` 12px · `{spacing.md}` 16px · `{spacing.lg}` 24px · `{spacing.xl}` 32px · `{spacing.xxl}` 48px · `{spacing.section}` 96px.
DESIGN.md-93- - Section interior padding: `{spacing.xxl}` (48px) on color-block sections.
DESIGN.md-94- - Card interior padding: `{spacing.lg}` (24px) on pricing cards and template tiles.

DESIGN.md:95: - Form input padding: `{spacing.sm}` 12px vertical · 14px horizontal.
DESIGN.md-96- - Button padding: `{spacing.xs}` 8px vertical · `{spacing.lg}` 24px horizontal for pill buttons (the asymmetric `8px 18px 10px` extracted on `button-secondary` nudges the type optically inside the pill).
DESIGN.md-97- - Universal rhythm constant: `{spacing.section}` (96px) — the vertical gap between major content sections holds across home, pricing, and FigJam pages.
DESIGN.md-99- ### Grid & Container
DESIGN.md-100-
